blocks.text: This Equipment Rental Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into as of {{date}}, between:
The Equipment covered by this Agreement is described as follows:

items: Rental Start: {{rental_start_date}} at {{rental_start_time}}
Rental End: {{rental_end_date}} at {{rental_end_time}}
Total Rental Period: {{rental_duration}}
Pickup Location: {{pickup_location}}
Return Location: {{return_location}}
Hourly Rate: {{hourly_rate}} per hour ({{hourly_rate_notes}})
Daily Rate: {{daily_rate}} per day
Weekly Rate: {{weekly_rate}} per week
Minimum Rental Period: {{minimum_rental_period}}
Base Rental Charge: {{base_rental_charge}}
Delivery Fee: {{delivery_fee}}
Pickup/Delivery Service: {{pickup_delivery_service}}
Insurance/Waiver Fee: {{insurance_fee}}
Taxes: {{taxes}}
Security Deposit: {{security_deposit}} (refundable)
Grand Total: {{grand_total}}
Use the Equipment only for its intended purpose and in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and all applicable laws and regulations.
Not operate the Equipment while under the influence of alcohol, drugs, or any impairing substance.
Not allow any unauthorized person to operate or use the Equipment.
Not modify, alter, or disassemble the Equipment without Owner's written consent.
Not use the Equipment for illegal purposes or in a negligent, reckless, or improper manner.
Inspect the Equipment upon delivery and report any damage or malfunction immediately.
Maintain the Equipment in good condition during the rental period.
Return the Equipment on time and in the same condition as at pickup (normal wear and tear excepted).
Not expose the Equipment to extreme conditions, moisture, or hazards beyond its design specifications.
{{renter_responsibilities}}
Only persons meeting the following qualifications may operate the Equipment:
{{qualification_1}}
{{qualification_2}}
{{qualification_3}}
Renter shall ensure all operators are trained and competent to operate the Equipment safely.
Renter is responsible for any damage caused by any operator.
Renter must maintain insurance covering the Equipment for the rental period.
Required coverage: {{insurance_coverage}}.
Owner's insurance (if any) is excess and secondary to Renter's coverage.
Renter must provide proof of insurance before taking possession.
Renter is responsible for the insurance deductible and any damage exceeding coverage.
{{insurance_terms}}
Renter must follow all safety instructions provided with the Equipment.
Renter must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when operating the Equipment.
Renter must inspect the Equipment before each use.
Renter must immediately stop using the Equipment if any malfunction, unusual noise, or safety concern arises.
Renter must secure the Equipment when not in use.
{{safety_requirements}}
Any damage to the Equipment occurring during the rental period.
Loss or theft of the Equipment.
The cost of repair or replacement, plus loss of use.
Any damage to property caused by the Equipment.
The full replacement value of the Equipment in case of total loss.
{{damage_terms}}
Security deposit: {{security_deposit}} held as assurance of Renter's obligations.
{{deposit_holding_method}}
Deposit will be refunded within {{deposit_refund_period}} after return and inspection, less any deductions.
Deductions may include: damage repair, cleaning, replacement costs, late fees, unpaid rental charges.
Late return fee: {{late_return_fee}} per hour or {{late_return_daily}} per day.
If Equipment is not returned within {{grace_period}} of the agreed return time, Owner may contact law enforcement for assistance.
Renter remains liable for all charges until Equipment is returned.
Renter may cancel with {{cancellation_days}} days notice for a full refund of prepaid charges.
Cancellation within {{cancellation_days}} days: {{cancellation_refund_percent}}% refund.
Cancellation within {{cancellation_short_notice_days}} days: no refund.
Owner may cancel for any reason and must refund all prepaid charges.

blocks.text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}. Any disputes shall be resolved in the courts of {{governing_state}} or through {{dispute_resolution_method}}.
This Agreement is the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, and agreements.
